behaviors.behavior: resolve_rollout_commit refuses a forged, backdated, unmerged branch commit (GIT_COMMITTER_DATE alone no longer grants rollout grace)
resolve_rollout_commit still grants grace to a genuine pre-rollout commit already reachable from the project's own corroborated trunk
resolve_rollout_commit withholds grace when no corroborated trunk boundary exists (no origin remote, non-trunk local branch name)

surface_verification.justification: internal F11-verifier trust-anchor fix (git ancestry check inside a verifier function); no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own to browser-verify -- verification is the unit test suite itself (F0).
